source.title: Call for Applicants - WCA Regulations Committee Leader (February 2026)
source.content:
Dear WCA Community,

There will be an appointment of a new WCA Regulations Committee (WRC) Leader, as Carter Kucala is stepping down. We would like to take this opportunity to thank Carter for leading the WRC since June 2024.
<!--break-->

Candidates are expected to fulfill their terms (24 months) and to spend at least 8 hours per week on average to work for the Regulations Committee. The qualities expected of candidates are:

* Strong leadership skills
* Attention to detail
* Expert knowledge of Regulations
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Good judgment and decision-making skills
* Excellent communication skills

The application period for candidates to submit their candidacy documents is from now until February 22, 2026, 23:59 UTC. Interested candidates can send the application privately to the Executive Assistants Team ([assistants@worldcubeassociation.org](mailto:assistants@worldcubeassociation.org)), CC’ing the WCA Board ([board@worldcubeassociation.org](mailto:board@worldcubeassociation.org)).

The candidacy documents must be in PDF format, and must include:

1. Brief personal introduction
2. Summary of activities done for the WCA
3. Ambitions as the WRC Leader

Candidates are additionally asked to send a copy of their applications which can be made public at the end of the application period.

The rights and duties of the WRC can be found in [WCA Motion 10.2025.9](https://documents.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/10.2025.9%20-%20Regulations%20Committee.pdf).

After the application period, the WCA Board will interview the most qualified applicants, make a selection by voting, and announce the new Leader, as described in Section 5 of [WCA Motion 10.2025.0](https://documents.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/10.2025.0%20-%20Committees%20and%20Teams.pdf).

Thanks for your candidacies and support.

translation.title: WCA 规则委员会负责人招募（2026 年 2 月）
translation.content:
各位 WCA 社区成员：

Carter Kucala 即将卸任，WCA 将任命新的规则委员会（WRC）负责人。借此机会，我们感谢 Carter 自 2024 年 6 月以来对 WRC 的领导。

候选人须能完成 24 个月的任期，并平均每周至少投入 8 小时处理规则委员会的工作。我们希望候选人具备以下能力：

* 出色的领导能力。
* 注重细节。
* 精通竞赛规则。
* 较强的分析和解决问题的能力。
* 良好的判断和决策能力。
* 出色的沟通能力。

申请自即日起开放，截止时间为 2026 年 2 月 22 日 23:59 UTC。有意申请者可将材料私下发送至执行助理团队（[assistants@worldcubeassociation.org](mailto:assistants@worldcubeassociation.org)），并抄送 WCA 董事会（[board@worldcubeassociation.org](mailto:board@worldcubeassociation.org)）。

申请材料须为 PDF 格式，并包括：

1. 简短的个人介绍。
2. 为 WCA 所做工作的概述。
3. 担任 WRC 负责人后的工作设想。

申请者还须提供一份可在申请截止后公开的申请材料副本。

WRC 的权利与职责见 [WCA 动议 10.2025.9](https://documents.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/10.2025.9%20-%20Regulations%20Committee.pdf)。

申请截止后，WCA 董事会将按照 [WCA 动议 10.2025.0](https://documents.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/10.2025.0%20-%20Committees%20and%20Teams.pdf)第 5 节的规定，面试最符合条件的申请者，通过投票选定并公布新负责人。

感谢大家的申请与支持。
